current.text: Ware moved from Miami to Milwaukee in the Giannis Antetokounmpo trade.
The latest projected opening lineup has him as the backup center behind Myles Turner. Kyle Kuzma starts at power forward in that lineup.
He has no locked-in starting role, and it is unclear how he fits with Myles Turner.
Experts expect him to play more than last season's 22 minutes. Projections range from a steady 25 to 30 minutes a night.
New coach Taylor Jenkins decides his role, and it is unclear whether Jenkins will give him a fantasy-friendly role. Milwaukee's rotation is the least clear in the league.
The newest rank call is in the 70s or 80s.
If he plays about 30 minutes a night or is named a starter, experts see him in the top 40s.
His free throws fell under 60% in the second half of last season.
His 40% three-point shooting is not expected to last.

durable.text: Elite rebounder with a high block rate. He also makes threes for a big.
Rarely passes. He has some of the lowest assist numbers in the top 200.
Very strong fantasy numbers per minute.
He is inconsistent and has lapses on offense and defense. In Miami he was benched for poor shot selection and team play, which caused problems with Erik Spoelstra.
He is a horrible defender, and this limited his minutes in Miami more than the coach did.
His off-court behavior was a distraction in Miami.
He is only 22. His potential is high and he fits best at center.
He is a 9-cat fluff player and is worth much more in category leagues than in points leagues.

note: Ware is a cheap source of rebounds, blocks and FG% with some threes, but he barely passes. That makes him a good fit for big-man builds that give up assists. Both sites put his value at 13 to 14 USD. Average costs are only 3.2 USD on Yahoo and 5.6 USD on ESPN, and he went for 5 USD in our league last season. Paying up to about 10 USD looks fine for a player ranked in the 70s whose upside is the top 40s. In the first weeks, check whether Taylor Jenkins starts him next to Myles Turner or uses him as the backup center, and whether his minutes rise above 25. Also watch whether his three-point and free-throw shooting holds.
